name: Flight Deck: Enterprise
summary:
Upgrade your cockpit posters with Flight Deck: the most immersive and hands-on Cessna 172 cockpit experience. For student pilot’s & licensed aviator alike, Flight Deck brings a true-to-size, high-fidelity 3D Cessna 172 cockpit into your living room.

Flight Deck is a digital to-scale cockpit, that complements simulator time, but is not a flight simulator. Flight Deck lets you physically move through flows and cockpit procedures on the ground using your own hands, in mixed reality, no cockpit posters require
